title: BoundlessJournal
description: The canonical journal committed by the time-oracle guest and decoded on-chain. This is the single contract shared by three enforcers: the zkVM guest (asserts it before committing), the DocumentTimeOracle contract (re-checks it on decode), and this JSON Schema (off-chain validation). ABI: (bytes32 documentHash, uint256 midpointMs, uint256 radiusMs). For a clean cut, documentHash is the cut's Merkle root.

document_hash.description: bytes32 document hash (the Roughtime nonce, or a cut's Merkle root).

midpoint_unix_ms.description: Claimed window midpoint (unix ms). Must be positive (guest + contract enforce).

radius_ms.description: Claimed window radius (ms). Must be positive (guest + contract enforce).
